So the complete 10-bit states I've visited so far in this run (bars, stems):
reset: 10100/10100
+ s1: 10100/00100
+ s1, b2: 11100/00100? Wait, ordering: after reset: (45,21) → 10100/00100. Then (45,21) → 10100/10100 (back to reset!). Then (42,26) → 11100/10100. (42,36) → 11110/10100. (42,41) → 11111/10100.
